title.zh: 卷一百〇五 志第五十八 禮八
title.raw: 卷一百〇五 志第五十八 禮八 Volume 105 Treatises 58: Rites 8

sentences.zh: 文宣王廟武成王廟先代陵廟諸神祠

translations.literal: Temples of the Cultured and Propagating King, the Martial Achievement King, Ancestral Mausoleum Temples, and Various Spirit Shrines
translations.idiomatic: Temples of the Cultured and Propagating King, the Martial Achievement King, Ancestral Mausoleum Temples, and Various Spirit Shrines

sentences.zh: 至聖文宣王。

translations.literal: The Most Sage Cultured and Propagating King.
translations.idiomatic: The Most Sage, Cultured and Propagating King.

sentences.zh: 唐開元末升為中祠，設從祀，禮令攝三公行事。

translations.literal: At the end of the Kaiyuan era of Tang it was elevated to a secondary shrine, collateral sacrifices were established, and ritual regulations required the three dukes to act by proxy in the ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Tang Kaiyuan reign it was raised to a secondary shrine, collateral sacrifices were instituted, and the rites required the three chief ministers to perform the ceremonies by proxy.

sentences.zh: 朱梁喪亂，從祀遂廢。

translations.literal: During the chaos of the Later Liang, collateral sacrifices were then abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Amid the turmoil of the Later Liang, collateral sacrifices were discontinued.

sentences.zh: 後唐長興二年，仍復從祀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Changxing of Later Tang, collateral sacrifices were again restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Later Tang Changxing era, collateral sacrifices were restored.

sentences.zh: 周顯德二年，別營國子監，置學舍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xiande of Zhou, a separate Imperial University was built and lecture halls were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Zhou Xiande era, a separate Imperial University was constructed and student quarters were provided.

sentences.zh: 宋因增修之，塑先聖、亞聖、十哲像，畫七十二賢及先儒二十一人像於東西廡之木壁，太祖親撰《先聖》、《亞聖讚》，十哲以下命文臣分讚之。

translations.literal: The Song dynasty thereupon enlarged and repaired it, molded images of the Former Sage, the Second Sage, and the Ten Wise Ones, and painted images of the Seventy-two Worthies and twenty-one Former Confucians on the wooden walls of the eastern and western cloisters; the Founder personally composed eulogies for the Former Sage and the Second Sage, and ordered civil officials to compose eulogies separately for those below the Ten Wise Ones.
translations.idiomatic: The Song continued to expand and refurbish the complex, casting statues of the Former Sage, the Second Sage, and the Ten Wise Ones, and painting the Seventy-two Worthies and twenty-one Former Confucians on the wooden walls of the east and west cloisters. Taizu himself wrote eulogies for the Former Sage and the Second Sage and directed civil officials to compose eulogies for the rest down through the Ten Wise Ones.

sentences.zh: 建隆中，凡三幸國子監，謁文宣王廟。

translations.literal: During the Jianlong era, he thrice visited the Imperial University and paid homage at the temple of the Cultured and Propagating King.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jianlong period the emperor visited the Imperial University three times and paid homage at the Cultured and Propagating King's temple.

sentences.zh: 太宗亦三謁廟。

translations.literal: Taizong also thrice visited the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong likewise visited the temple on three occasions.

sentences.zh: 詔繪三禮器物、制度於國學講論堂木壁。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the vessels, implements, and institutions of the Three Rites be painted on the wooden walls of the lecture hall of the National Academy.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ritual vessels, implements, and institutions described in the Three Rites painted on the wooden walls of the National Academy's lecture hall.

sentences.zh: 又命河南府建國子監文宣王廟，置官講說及賜《九經》書。

translations.literal: He also ordered Henan Prefecture to build a temple of the Cultured and Propagating King at the Imperial University, appoint officials to lecture, and bestow copies of the Nine Classics.
translations.idiomatic: He also directed Henan Prefecture to erect a Cultured and Propagating King temple at the Imperial University, appoint lecturers, and grant copies of the Nine Classics.

sentences.zh: 二年五月乙卯，詔追封十哲為公，七十二弟子為侯，先儒為伯或贈官。

translations.literal: On yimao, the fifth month of the second year, an edict posthumously enfeoffed the Ten Wise Ones as dukes, the seventy-two disciples as marquises, and the Former Confucians as earls or granted them official titles.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the fifth month of the second year, an edict posthumously enfeoffed the Ten Wise Ones as dukes, the seventy-two disciples as marquises, and the Former Confucians as earls or conferred official titles upon them.

sentences.zh: 親製《玄聖文宣王讚》，命宰相等撰顏子以下讚，留親奠祭器於廟中，從官立石刻名。

translations.literal: He personally composed the 'Eulogy of the Mysterious Sage, Cultured and Propagating King,' ordered the chief ministers and others to compose eulogies for Yanzi and those below, left the ritual vessels he had personally offered in the temple, and had attending officials erect stone tablets inscribed with their names.
translations.idiomatic: He personally composed the Eulogy of the Mysterious Sage, Cultured and Propagating King, directed the chief ministers and others to write eulogies for Yan Hui and those ranked below him, left the sacrificial vessels he had personally presented in the temple, and had his attending officials erect stone tablets bearing their names.

sentences.zh: 既以國諱，改諡至聖文宣王。

translations.literal: Thereupon, because of the dynastic taboo, the posthumous title was changed to the Most Sage, Cultured and Propagating King.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the dynastic naming taboo, the posthumous title was then changed to the Most Sage, Cultured and Propagating King.

sentences.zh: 賜孔氏錢帛，錄親屬五人並賜出身，又賜太宗御製、禦書一百五十卷，銀器八百兩。

translations.literal: He bestowed money and silks on the Kong clan, enrolled five kinsmen and granted them official status, and further bestowed one hundred fifty volumes of Taizong's imperial compositions and imperial calligraphy, and eight hundred taels of silver vessels.
translations.idiomatic: He granted money and silks to the Kong clan, enrolled five kinsmen and conferred official status upon them, and also bestowed one hundred fifty volumes of Taizong's writings and imperial calligraphy together with eight hundred taels' worth of silver vessels.

sentences.zh: 詔太常禮院定州縣釋奠器數：先聖、先師每坐酒尊一、籩豆八、簋二、簠二、俎三、罍一、洗一、篚一，尊皆加勺、冪，各置於坫，巾共二，燭二，爵共四，坫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office to fix the number of vessels for district and prefectural school sacrifices: for the Former Sage and Former Teacher, at each seat one wine vessel, eight baskets and stands, two grain bowls, two grain trays, three meat stands, one jar, one basin, and one hamper; all wine vessels were to have ladles and covers, each set upon a spirit altar, with two cloths in all, two candles, four goblets in all, and spirit altars.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office to prescribe the sacrificial vessels for district and prefectural school ceremonies: for the Former Sage and Former Teacher, each seat was to have one wine vessel, eight baskets and stands, two grain bowls, two grain trays, three meat stands, one jar, one basin, and one hamper; every wine vessel was to have a ladle and cover and be set on a spirit altar, with two cloths, two candles, four goblets, and spirit altars in all.

sentences.zh: 有從祀之處，諸坐各籩二、豆二、簋一、簠一、俎一、燭一、爵一。

translations.literal: Where collateral sacrifices were offered, at each seat there were to be two baskets, two stands, one grain bowl, one grain tray, one meat stand, one candle, and one goblet.
translations.idiomatic: At seats with collateral sacrifices, each was to have two baskets, two stands, one grain bowl, one grain tray, one meat stand, one candle, and one goblet.

sentences.zh: 仁宗再幸國子監，謁文宣王廟，皆再拜焉。

translations.literal: Renzong again visited the Imperial University and paid homage at the temple of the Cultured and Propagating King, each time performing the double obeisance.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong visited the Imperial University again and paid homage at the Cultured and Propagating King's temple, bowing twice on each occasion.

sentences.zh: 熙寧七年，判國子監常秩等請立孟軻、揚雄像於廟廷，仍賜爵號，又請追尊孔子以帝號。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining, Chang Zhi and others, who were acting as superintendents of the Imperial University, requested that images of Meng Ke and Yang Xiong be erected in the temple court, that noble titles still be granted, and further requested that Confucius be posthumously honored with an imperial title.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xining, Acting Superintendent of the Imperial University Chang Zhi and others asked that statues of Mencius and Yang Xiong be set up in the temple courtyard, that noble titles be conferred as well, and that Confucius be posthumously honored with an imperial title.

sentences.zh: 下兩製禮官詳定，以為非是而止。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the ritual officials of the two academies for detailed deliberation, who deemed it improper and thereupon stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred to the ritual specialists of the two academies for review; they judged it improper, and the proposals were dropped.

sentences.zh: 京兆府學教授蔣夔請以顏回為兗國公，毋稱先師，而祭不讀祝，儀物一切降殺，而進閔子騫九人亦在祀典。

translations.literal: Jiang Kui, lecturer at the Capital Metropolitan Prefecture school, requested that Yan Hui be enfeoffed as Duke of Yan and no longer called Former Teacher, that the sacrifice omit the reading of the prayer, that ritual implements be reduced in every respect, and that the advancement of Min Ziqian and nine others was already in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Kui, lecturer at the Capital Metropolitan Prefecture school, asked that Yan Hui be enfeoffed as Duke of Yan, no longer styled Former Teacher, that sacrifices omit the prayer recitation and that all ritual implements be reduced in rank, while noting that elevating Min Ziqian and nine others was already provided for in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 禮官以孔子、顏子稱號，曆代各有據依，難輒更改，儀物祝獻，亦難降殺，所請九人，已在祀典。

translations.literal: The ritual officials stated that the titles of Confucius and Yanzi each had authoritative precedents through successive dynasties and could not readily be changed; the ritual implements and prayer offerings likewise could not readily be reduced, and the nine persons requested were already in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials replied that the titles of Confucius and Yan Hui rested on precedents from successive dynasties and could not lightly be altered; the ritual implements and prayer offerings likewise could not readily be reduced, and the nine men in question were already included in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 熙寧祀儀，十哲皆為從祀，惟州縣釋奠未載。

translations.literal: In the Xining sacrificial regulations, the Ten Wise Ones were all collateral sacrifices, but this was not recorded for district and prefectural school sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xining sacrificial regulations the Ten Wise Ones were all collateral sacrifices, but district and prefectural ceremonies had not yet been recorded accordingly.

sentences.zh: 請自今二京及諸州春秋釋奠，並準熙寧祀儀。

translations.literal: They requested that from now on the spring and autumn school sacrifices in the two capitals and all prefectures follow the Xining sacrificial regulations.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that henceforth the spring and autumn school sacrifices in both capitals and all prefectures follow the Xining regulations.

sentences.zh: 詔封孟軻鄒國公。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed Meng Ke as Duke of Zou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Mencius as Duke of Zou.

sentences.zh: 晉州州學教授陸長愈請春秋釋奠，孟子宜與顏子並配。

translations.literal: Lu Changyu, lecturer at the Jinzhou prefectural school, requested that at the spring and autumn school sacrifices Mencius ought to share equal placement with Yanzi.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Changyu, lecturer at the Jinzhou prefectural school, asked that at the spring and autumn school sacrifices Mencius be given equal placement with Yan Hui.

sentences.zh: 議者以謂凡配享、從祀，皆孔子同時之人，今以孟軻並配，非是。

translations.literal: Discussants held that all who received equal placement or collateral sacrifice were contemporaries of Confucius, and that to grant Meng Ke equal placement now would be improper.
translations.idiomatic: Critics argued that everyone granted equal placement or collateral sacrifice had been a contemporary of Confucius, and that giving Mencius equal placement would be improper.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：“唐貞觀以漢伏勝、高堂生、晉杜預、範寧之徒與顏子俱配享，至今從祀，豈必同時？

translations.literal: The ritual officials said: 'In the Zhenguan era of Tang, Fu Sheng of Han, Gao Tang Sheng, Du Yu of Jin, Fan Ning, and others were granted equal placement with Yanzi, and to this day they receive collateral sacrifice—must they necessarily have been contemporaries?
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials replied: 'In the Tang Zhenguan era, the Han scholar Fu Sheng, Gao Tang Sheng, the Jin scholars Du Yu and Fan Ning, and others were granted equal placement with Yan Hui and remain collateral sacrifices to this day—must they all have been contemporaries?

sentences.zh: 孟子於孔門當在顏子之列，至於荀況、揚雄、韓愈，皆發明先聖之道，有益學者，久未配食，誠闕典也。

translations.literal: Mencius within the school of Confucius ought to rank with Yanzi; as for Xun Kuang, Yang Xiong, and Han Yu, all elucidated the Way of the Former Sage and benefited scholars, yet long went without sacrificial shares—a true lacuna in the canon.
translations.idiomatic: Within Confucius's school Mencius belongs in Yan Hui's company; as for Xunzi, Yang Xiong, and Han Yu, each clarified the Former Sage's Way and benefited students, yet for long they lacked sacrificial shares—a genuine gap in the canon.

sentences.zh: 請自今春秋釋奠，以孟子配食，荀況、揚雄、韓愈並加封爵，以世次先後，從祀於左丘明二十一賢之間。

translations.literal: They requested that from now on at the spring and autumn school sacrifices Mencius receive sacrificial shares, that Xun Kuang, Yang Xiong, and Han Yu all be granted enfeoffments, and that according to chronological order they receive collateral sacrifice among the twenty-one worthies beginning with Zuo Qiuming.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that henceforth at the spring and autumn school sacrifices Mencius receive sacrificial shares, that Xunzi, Yang Xiong, and Han Yu be enfeoffed, and that by chronological order they be given collateral sacrifice among the twenty-one worthies beginning with Zuo Qiuming.

sentences.zh: 自國子監及天下學廟，皆塑鄒國公像，冠服同兗國公。

translations.literal: From the Imperial University to school temples throughout the realm, images of the Duke of Zou were to be molded, with caps and robes the same as those of the Duke of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: From the Imperial University to school temples throughout the empire, statues of the Duke of Zou were to be cast, with caps and robes matching those of the Duke of Yan.

sentences.zh: 仍繪荀況等像於從祀：荀況，左丘明下；

translations.literal: Images of Xun Kuang and others were still to be painted for collateral sacrifice: Xun Kuang below Zuo Qiuming;
translations.idiomatic: Their images were also to be painted for collateral sacrifice: Xunzi below Zuo Qiuming;

sentences.zh: 揚雄，劉向下；

translations.literal: Yang Xiong below Liu Xiang;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xiong below Liu Xiang;

sentences.zh: 韓愈，範寧下。

translations.literal: Han Yu below Fan Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu below Fan Ning.

sentences.zh: 冠服各從封爵。

translations.literal: Caps and robes for each were to follow his enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Each man's cap and robes were to follow his enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: ”詔如禮部議，荀況封蘭陵伯，揚雄封成都伯，韓愈封昌黎伯，令學士院撰讚文。

translations.literal: ' An edict followed the Ministry of Rites' proposal: Xun Kuang was enfeoffed as Earl of Lanling, Yang Xiong as Earl of Chengdu, Han Yu as Earl of Changli, and the Hanlin Academy was ordered to compose eulogies.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict adopted the Ministry of Rites' proposal: Xunzi was enfeoffed as Earl of Lanling, Yang Xiong as Earl of Chengdu, Han Yu as Earl of Changli, and the Hanlin Academy was directed to compose eulogies.

sentences.zh: 又詔太常寺修四孟釋菜儀。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered the Directorate of Sacrifices to compile the ritual for the four Mencius vegetable offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict directed the Directorate of Sacrifices to compile the ritual for the four Mencius vegetable offerings.

sentences.zh: 元祐六年，幸太學，先詣國子監至聖文宣王殿行釋奠禮，一獻再拜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanyou, the emperor visited the Imperial College, first proceeding to the hall of the Most Sage, Cultured and Propagating King at the Imperial University to perform the school sacrifice, offering once and bowing twice.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanyou the emperor visited the Imperial College, first proceeding to the Most Sage, Cultured and Propagating King hall at the Imperial University to perform the school sacrifice, offering once and bowing twice.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，封孔鯉為泗水侯，孔伋為沂水侯。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning, Kong Li was enfeoffed as Marquis of Sishui and Kong Ji as Marquis of Yishui.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongning era, Kong Li was enfeoffed as Marquis of Sishui and Kong Ji as Marquis of Yishui.

sentences.zh: 詔：“古者，學必祭先師，況都城近郊，大辟黌舍，聚四方之士，多且數千，宜建文宣王廟，以便薦獻。

translations.literal: An edict stated: 'In antiquity, schools invariably sacrificed to the Former Teacher; moreover, at the outskirts of the capital, vast lecture halls were opened, gathering scholars from the four quarters, many and numbering in the thousands—it is fitting to build a temple of the Cultured and Propagating King to facilitate offerings.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: 'In antiquity every school sacrificed to the Former Teacher; at the capital's outskirts vast lecture halls gather scholars from all directions, often numbering in the thousands. A Cultured and Propagating King temple should be built to facilitate offerings.

sentences.zh: ”又詔：“王安石可配享孔子廟，位於鄒國公之次。

translations.literal: ' Another edict stated: 'Wang Anshi may receive equal placement in Confucius's temple, his seat ranking after the Duke of Zou.
translations.idiomatic: ' Another edict stated: 'Wang Anshi may receive equal placement in Confucius's temple, ranking after the Duke of Zou.

sentences.zh: ” 國子監丞趙子櫟言：“唐封孔子為文宣王，其廟像，內出王者袞冕衣之。

translations.literal: ' The assistant director of the Imperial University, Zhao Zili, said: 'In Tang, Confucius was enfeoffed as Cultured and Propagating King; for his temple image, robes and coronets issued from within the palace were used to clothe him as a king.
translations.idiomatic: ' Assistant Director of the Imperial University Zhao Zili said: 'The Tang enfeoffed Confucius as Cultured and Propagating King, and his temple image was clothed in kingly robes and coronets issued from within the palace.

sentences.zh: 今乃循五代故製，服上公之服。

translations.literal: Now we merely follow the old regulations of the Five Dynasties and clothe him in the robes of a senior duke.
translations.idiomatic: Now we merely follow the Five Dynasties precedent and dress him in a senior duke's robes.

sentences.zh: 七十二子皆周人，而衣冠率用漢製，非是。

translations.literal: The seventy-two disciples were all men of Zhou, yet their caps and robes uniformly use Han designs—this is improper.
translations.idiomatic: The seventy-two disciples were all men of Zhou, yet their caps and robes uniformly follow Han designs, which is improper.

sentences.zh: ”詔孔子仍舊，七十二子易以周之冕服。

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered that Confucius remain as before, while the seventy-two disciples were to be changed to Zhou coronets and robes.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict left Confucius's dress unchanged but ordered the seventy-two disciples clothed in Zhou coronets and robes.

sentences.zh: 又詔辟雍文宣王殿以“大成”為名。

translations.literal: Another edict named the hall of the Cultured and Propagating King at the Imperial Academy 'Great Completion.'
translations.idiomatic: Another edict named the Cultured and Propagating King hall at the Imperial Academy Great Completion.

sentences.zh: 帝幸國子監，謁文宣王殿，皆再拜行酌獻禮，遣官分奠兗國公而下。

translations.literal: The emperor visited the Imperial University and paid homage at the hall of the Cultured and Propagating King, each time bowing twice and performing the libation offering, and dispatched officials to offer sacrifices separately to the Duke of Yan and those below.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited the Imperial University and paid homage at the Cultured and Propagating King hall, bowing twice and performing the libation offering each time, and dispatched officials to offer sacrifices separately to the Duke of Yan and those ranked below him.

sentences.zh: 國子司業蔣靜言：“先聖與門人通被冕服，無別。

translations.literal: Jiang Jing, vice director of the Imperial University, said: 'The Former Sage and his disciples alike wore coronets and robes without distinction.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Imperial University Jiang Jing said: 'The Former Sage and his disciples alike wore coronets and robes without distinction.

sentences.zh: 配享、從祀之人，當從所封之爵，服周之服，公之袞冕九章，侯、伯之鷩冕七章。

translations.literal: Those receiving equal placement or collateral sacrifice ought to follow the ranks of their enfeoffments and wear Zhou dress: dukes in nine-patterned robes and coronets, marquises and earls in seven-patterned pheasant coronets.
translations.idiomatic: Those granted equal placement or collateral sacrifice should follow their enfeoffed ranks and wear Zhou dress: dukes in nine-patterned robes and coronets, marquises and earls in seven-patterned pheasant coronets.

sentences.zh: 袞，公服也，達於上。

translations.literal: The nine-patterned robe is the dress of a duke and extends upward.
translations.idiomatic: The nine-patterned robe is ducal dress and ranks above the others.

sentences.zh: 鄭氏謂公袞無升龍，誤矣。

translations.literal: Master Zheng's claim that a duke's nine-patterned robe lacks ascending dragons is mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xuan's claim that a duke's nine-patterned robe lacks ascending dragons is mistaken.

sentences.zh: 考《周官》司服所掌，則公之冕與王同；

translations.literal: Examining what the Director of Attire in the Offices of Zhou administers, a duke's coronet is the same as the king's;
translations.idiomatic: According to the Director of Attire in the Offices of Zhou, a duke's coronet matches the king's;

sentences.zh: 弁師所掌，則公之冕與王異。

translations.literal: what the Cap Master administers shows that a duke's coronet differs from the king's.
translations.idiomatic: but under the Cap Master it differs from the king's.

sentences.zh: 今既考正配享、從祀之服，亦宜考正先聖之冕服。

translations.literal: Now that the dress of those with equal placement and collateral sacrifice has been examined and corrected, the Former Sage's coronet and robes ought likewise to be examined and corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the dress of those with equal placement and collateral sacrifice has been corrected, the Former Sage's coronet and robes should be corrected as well.

sentences.zh: ”於是增文宣王冕為十有二旒。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon the coronet of the Cultured and Propagating King was increased to twelve tassels.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thereupon the Cultured and Propagating King's coronet was increased to twelve tassels.

sentences.zh: 大觀二年，從通仕郎侯孟請，繪子思像，從祀於左丘明二十四賢之間。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daguan, following the request of the gentleman for general service Hou Meng, an image of Zisi was painted and he was given collateral sacrifice among the twenty-four worthies beginning with Zuo Qiuming.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Daguan, at the request of Gentleman for General Service Hou Meng, an image of Zisi was painted and he was given collateral sacrifice among the twenty-four worthies beginning with Zuo Qiuming.

sentences.zh: 議禮局言：“建隆三年，詔國子監廟門立戟十六，用正一品禮。

translations.literal: The Bureau for Deliberating on Ritual said: 'In the third year of Jianlong, an edict ordered sixteen halberds erected at the gate of the Imperial University temple, using the ritual of the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau for Deliberating on Ritual said: 'In the third year of Jianlong an edict ordered sixteen halberds erected at the Imperial University temple gate, using first-rank ritual.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符二年，賜曲阜廟桓圭，從上公之製。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the Qufu temple was granted a ceremonial jade tablet, following the regulations for a senior duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Dazhong Xiangfu the Qufu temple was granted a ceremonial jade tablet following senior-duke regulations.

sentences.zh: 又《史記·弟子傳》曰，受業身通六藝者七十有七人，自顏回至公孫龍三十五人頗有年名及受業見於書傳，四十二人姓名僅存。

translations.literal: Moreover, the 'Biographies of the Disciples' in the Records of the Grand Historian states that those who received instruction and personally mastered the Six Arts numbered seventy-seven; from Yan Hui to Gongsun Long, thirty-five had fairly complete biographical records and instruction recorded in written traditions, while forty-two had only their names preserved.
translations.idiomatic: The Biographies of the Disciples in the Records of the Grand Historian also states that seventy-seven men received instruction and personally mastered the Six Arts; from Yan Hui to Gongsun Long, thirty-five have fairly complete biographical records in written sources, while forty-two are known only by name.

sentences.zh: 《家語》曰，七十二弟子皆升堂入室者。

translations.literal: The Family Sayings states that all seventy-two disciples had ascended the hall and entered the inner chamber.
translations.idiomatic: The Family Sayings states that all seventy-two disciples had ascended the hall and entered the inner chamber.

sentences.zh: 按《唐會要》七十七人，而《開元禮》止七十二人，又復去取不一。

translations.literal: According to the Tang Institutional Compendium there were seventy-seven, whereas the Kaiyuan Rites listed only seventy-two, and again the selections differed.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang Institutional Compendium lists seventy-seven, whereas the Kaiyuan Rites lists only seventy-two, and the selections differ again.

sentences.zh: 本朝議臣，斷以七十二子之說，取琴張等五人，而去公夏首等十人。

translations.literal: Deliberating officials of this dynasty decided in favor of the account of seventy-two disciples, taking Qin Zhang and four others while removing Gongxia Shou and nine others.
translations.idiomatic: Deliberating officials of this dynasty adopted the account of seventy-two disciples, retaining Qin Zhang and four others while removing Gongxia Shou and nine others.

sentences.zh: 今以《家語》、《史記》參定，公夏首、後處、公肩定、顏祖、鄡單、罕父黑、秦商、原抗、樂欬、廉潔，《唐會要》、《開元禮》亦互見之，皆有伯爵，載於祀典。

translations.literal: Now, collating the Family Sayings and the Records of the Grand Historian, Gongxia Shou, Hou Chu, Gongjian Ding, Yan Zu, Zou Dan, Hanfu Hei, Qin Shang, Yuan Kang, Yue Chi, and Lian Jie also appear in the Tang Institutional Compendium and the Kaiyuan Rites, all had earldoms, and are recorded in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: Collating the Family Sayings and the Records of the Grand Historian, Gongxia Shou, Hou Chu, Gongjian Ding, Yan Zu, Zou Dan, Hanfu Hei, Qin Shang, Yuan Kang, Yue Chi, and Lian Jie also appear in the Tang Institutional Compendium and the Kaiyuan Rites; each held an earldom and is recorded in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 請追贈侯爵，使預祭享。

translations.literal: We request that marquisates be posthumously granted so that they may participate in sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that marquisates be posthumously granted so they may participate in sacrifices.

sentences.zh: ”詔封公夏首钜平侯，後處膠東侯，公肩定梁父侯，顏祖富陽候，鄡單聊城侯，罕父黑祈鄉侯，秦商馮翊候，原抗樂平侯，樂欬建成侯，廉潔胙城侯。

translations.literal: ' An edict enfeoffed Gongxia Shou as Marquis of Juping, Hou Chu as Marquis of Jiaodong, Gongjian Ding as Marquis of Liangfu, Yan Zu as Marquis of Fuyang, Zou Dan as Marquis of Liaocheng, Hanfu Hei as Marquis of Qixiang, Qin Shang as Marquis of Fengyi, Yuan Kang as Marquis of Yueping, Yue Chi as Marquis of Jiancheng, and Lian Jie as Marquis of Zuocheng.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict enfeoffed Gongxia Shou as Marquis of Juping, Hou Chu as Marquis of Jiaodong, Gongjian Ding as Marquis of Liangfu, Yan Zu as Marquis of Fuyang, Zou Dan as Marquis of Liaocheng, Hanfu Hei as Marquis of Qixiang, Qin Shang as Marquis of Fengyi, Yuan Kang as Marquis of Yueping, Yue Chi as Marquis of Jiancheng, and Lian Jie as Marquis of Zuocheng.

sentences.zh: 又詔改封曾參武城侯，顓孫師潁川侯，南宮縚汶陽侯，司馬耕睢陽侯，琴張陽平侯，左丘明中都伯，穀梁赤睢陵伯，戴聖考城伯，以所封犯先聖諱也。

translations.literal: Another edict changed the enfeoffments of Zeng Shen to Marquis of Wucheng, Zhuansun Shi to Marquis of Yingchuan, Nangong Tao to Marquis of Wenyang, Sima Geng to Marquis of Suiyang, Qin Zhang to Marquis of Yangping, Zuo Qiuming to Earl of Zhongdu, Guliang Chi to Earl of Suiling, and Dai Sheng to Earl of Kaocheng, because their former enfeoffments violated taboos of the Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict changed the enfeoffments because the former titles violated taboos of the Former Sage: Zeng Shen became Marquis of Wucheng, Zhuansun Shi Marquis of Yingchuan, Nangong Tao Marquis of Wenyang, Sima Geng Marquis of Suiyang, Qin Zhang Marquis of Yangping, Zuo Qiuming Earl of Zhongdu, Guliang Chi Earl of Suiling, and Dai Sheng Earl of Kaocheng.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，詔封王安石舒王，配享；

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, an edict enfeoffed Wang Anshi as King of Shu, with equal placement;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenghe an edict enfeoffed Wang Anshi as King of Shu and granted him equal placement;

sentences.zh: 安石子雱臨川伯，從祀。

translations.literal: his son Wang Pang was made Earl of Linchuan and given collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: his son Wang Pang was made Earl of Linchuan and given collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 《新儀》成，以孟春元日釋菜，仲春、仲秋上丁日釋奠。

translations.literal: When the New Regulations were completed, vegetable offerings were made on the first day of the first month of spring, and school sacrifices on the upper ding days of the second months of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: When the New Regulations were completed, vegetable offerings were held on the first day of the first month of spring, and school sacrifices on the upper ding days of the second months of spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 以兗國公顏回、鄒國公孟軻、舒王王安石配享殿上；

translations.literal: The Duke of Yan Yan Hui, the Duke of Zou Meng Ke, and the King of Shu Wang Anshi received equal placement in the main hall;
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Yan Yan Hui, the Duke of Zou Mencius, and the King of Shu Wang Anshi received equal placement in the main hall;

sentences.zh: 琅邪公閔損、東平公冉耕、下邳公冉雍、臨淄公宰予、黎陽公端木賜並西向，彭城公冉求、河內公仲由、丹陽公言偃、河東公卜商、武城侯曾參並東向；

translations.literal: the Duke of Langye Min Sun, the Duke of Dongping Ran Geng, the Duke of Xiapi Ran Yong, the Duke of Linzi Zai Yu, and the Duke of Liyang Duanmu Ci all faced west; the Duke of Pengcheng Ran Qiu, the Duke of Henei Zhong You, the Duke of Danyang Yan Yan, the Duke of Hedong Bu Shang, and the Marquis of Wucheng Zeng Shen all faced east;
translations.idiomatic: the Duke of Langye Min Sun, the Duke of Dongping Ran Geng, the Duke of Xiapi Ran Yong, the Duke of Linzi Zai Yu, and the Duke of Liyang Duanmu Ci all faced west; the Duke of Pengcheng Ran Qiu, the Duke of Henei Zhong You, the Duke of Danyang Yan Yan, the Duke of Hedong Bu Shang, and the Marquis of Wucheng Zeng Shen all faced east;

sentences.zh: 東廡。

translations.literal: in the eastern cloister.
translations.idiomatic: in the eastern cloister.

sentences.zh: 潁川侯顓孫師以下至成都伯揚雄四十九人並西向，西廡，長山侯林放以下至臨川伯王雱四十八人並東向。

translations.literal: the Marquis of Yingchuan Zhuansun Shi and forty-eight others down to the Earl of Chengdu Yang Xiong, forty-nine in all, faced west in the western cloister; the Marquis of Changshan Lin Fang and forty-seven others down to the Earl of Linchuan Wang Pang, forty-eight in all, faced east.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Yingchuan Zhuansun Shi and forty-eight others down to the Earl of Chengdu Yang Xiong, forty-nine in all, faced west in the western cloister; the Marquis of Changshan Lin Fang and forty-seven others down to the Earl of Linchuan Wang Pang, forty-eight in all, faced east.

sentences.zh: 頒辟雍大成殿名於諸路州學。

translations.literal: The name of the Imperial Academy's Great Completion Hall was promulgated to prefectural schools in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The name Great Completion Hall was promulgated to prefectural schools in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 五年，太常寺言：“兗州鄒縣孟子廟，詔以樂正子配享，公孫醜以下從祀，皆擬定其封爵：樂正子克利國侯，公孫醜壽光伯，萬章博興伯，告子不害東阿伯，孟仲子新泰伯，陳臻蓬萊伯，充虞昌樂伯，屋廬連奉符伯，徐辟仙源伯，陳代沂水伯，彭更雷澤伯，公都子平陰伯，鹹丘蒙須城伯，高子泗水伯，桃應膠水伯，盆成括萊陽伯，季孫豐城伯，子叔承陽伯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the Directorate of Sacrifices said: 'At the Mencius temple in Zou County, Yanzhou, an edict granted Yue Zhengzi equal placement and Gongsun Chou and those below collateral sacrifice, all with proposed enfeoffments: Yue Zhengzi as Marquis of Keguo, Gongsun Chou as Earl of Shouguang, Wan Zhang as Earl of Boxing, Gaozi Buhai as Earl of Dong'e, Meng Zhongzi as Earl of Xintai, Chen Zhen as Earl of Penglai, Chong Yu as Earl of Changle, Wulu Lian as Earl of Fengfu, Xu Bi as Earl of Xianyuan, Chen Dai as Earl of Yishui, Peng Geng as Earl of Leize, Gongduzi as Earl of Pingyin, Xianqiumeng as Earl of Xucheng, Gaozi as Earl of Sishui, Tao Ying as Earl of Jiaoshui, Pencheng Kuo as Earl of Laiyang, Jisun as Earl of Fengcheng, and Zishu as Earl of Chengyang.

sentences.zh: ”大晟樂成，詔下國子學選諸生肄習，上丁釋奠，奏於堂上，以祀先聖。

translations.literal: ' When the Dasheng music was completed, an edict ordered the Imperial University to select students to study it; at the upper ding school sacrifice it was performed in the hall to honor the Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: ' When the Dasheng music was completed, an edict directed the Imperial University to select students to study it; at the upper ding school sacrifice it was performed in the hall to honor the Former Sage.

sentences.zh: 時又有算學。

translations.literal: At this time there was also a School of Mathematics.
translations.idiomatic: At this time there was also a School of Mathematics.

sentences.zh: 大觀三年，禮部、太常寺請以文宣王為先師，兗、鄒、荊三國公配享，十哲從祀。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daguan, the Ministry of Rites and the Directorate of Sacrifices requested that the Cultured and Propagating King be designated Former Teacher, with the dukes of Yan, Zou, and Jing receiving equal placement and the Ten Wise Ones collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Daguan the Ministry of Rites and the Directorate of Sacrifices asked that the Cultured and Propagating King be designated Former Teacher, with the dukes of Yan, Zou, and Jing receiving equal placement and the Ten Wise Ones collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 自昔著名算數者畫像兩廡，請加賜五等爵，隨所封以定其服。

translations.literal: Images of those famous for mathematics from former times were painted in both cloisters; they requested that five ranks of nobility be additionally granted, with dress determined according to each enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Images of famous mathematicians of former times were painted in both cloisters; they asked that five ranks of nobility be granted, with dress determined by each enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 於是中書舍人張邦昌定算學：封風後上穀公，箕子遼東公，周大夫商高鬱夷公，大撓涿鹿公，隸首陽周公，容成平都公，常儀原都公，鬼俞區宜都公，商巫鹹河東公，晉史蘇晉陽伯，秦卜徒父潁陽伯，晉卜偃平陽伯，魯梓慎汝陽伯，晉史趙高都伯，魯卜楚丘昌衍伯，鄭裨灶滎陽伯，趙史墨易陽伯，周榮方美陽伯，齊甘德菑川伯，魏石申隆慮伯，漢鮮於妄人清泉伯，耿壽昌安定伯，夏侯勝任城伯，京房樂平伯，翼奉良成伯，李尋平陵伯，張衡西鄂伯，周興慎陽伯，單颺湖陸伯，樊英魯陽伯，晉郭璞聞喜伯，宋何承天昌盧伯，北齊宋景業廣宗伯，隋蕭吉臨湘伯，臨孝恭親豐伯，張胄玄東光伯，周王樸東平伯，漢鄧平新野子，劉洪蒙陰子，魏管輅平原子，吳趙逵穀城子，宋祖衝之範陽子，後魏商紹長樂子，北齊信都芳樂城子，北齊許遵高陽子，隋耿詢湖熟子，劉焯昌亭子，劉炫景城子，唐傅仁均博平子，王孝通介休子，瞿曇羅居延子，李淳風昌樂子，王希明琅琊子，李鼎祚讚皇子，邊岡成安子，漢郎顗觀陽子，襄楷隰陰子，司馬季主夏陽男，落下閎閬中男，嚴君平廣都男，魏劉徽淄鄉男，晉薑岌成紀男，張丘建信成男，夏侯陽平陸男，後周甄鸞無極男，隋盧大翼成平男。

sentences.zh: 尋詔以黃帝為先師。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter an edict made the Yellow Emperor the Former Teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter an edict made the Yellow Emperor the Former Teacher.

sentences.zh: 禮部員外郎吳時言：“書畫之學，教養生徒，使知以孔子為師，此道德之所以一也。

translations.literal: Wu Shi, an outer official of the Ministry of Rites, said: 'The schools of calligraphy and painting educate and nurture students so that they know to take Confucius as teacher—this is how moral principle is unified.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shi, outer official of the Ministry of Rites, said: 'The schools of calligraphy and painting educate students so they know to take Confucius as teacher—this is how moral principle is unified.

sentences.zh: 若每學建立殿宇，則配食、從祀，難於其人。

translations.literal: If every school erects its own hall, it will be difficult to determine who receives sacrificial shares or collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: If every school erects its own hall, it will be difficult to decide who receives sacrificial shares or collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 請春秋釋奠，止令書畫博士量率職事生員，陪預執事，庶使知所宗師。

translations.literal: We request that at the spring and autumn school sacrifices only the calligraphy and painting erudites, together with a measured number of student officers on duty, accompany and participate in the ceremonies, so that they may know whom they revere as master.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that at the spring and autumn school sacrifices only the calligraphy and painting erudites, together with a measured number of student officers on duty, accompany the ceremonies so students may know whom they revere as master.

sentences.zh: 醫學亦準此。

translations.literal: The School of Medicine should follow the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: The School of Medicine should follow the same rule.

sentences.zh: ”詔皆從之。

translations.literal: ' An edict approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 其釋奠之禮：景德四年，同判太常禮院李維言：“按《開寶通禮》，諸州釋奠，並刺史致齋三日，從祭之官齋於公館。

translations.literal: The ritual for school sacrifices: In the fourth year of Jingde, Li Wei, who jointly adjudicated the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office, said: 'According to the Comprehensive Rites of the Kaibao era, for prefectural school sacrifices the prefect fasted for three days, and officials participating in the sacrifice fasted at the official residence.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual for school sacrifices: In the fourth year of Jingde, Li Wei of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office said: 'According to the Comprehensive Rites of the Kaibao era, for prefectural school sacrifices the prefect fasted for three days and participating officials fasted at the official residence.

sentences.zh: 祭日，刺史為初獻，上佐為亞獻，博士為終獻。

translations.literal: On the day of sacrifice, the prefect served as primary offerer, the chief aide as secondary offerer, and the erudite as final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of sacrifice the prefect served as primary offerer, the chief aide as secondary offerer, and the erudite as final offerer.

sentences.zh: 今諸州長吏不親行祀，非尊師重教之道。

translations.literal: Now the chief officials of the prefectures do not personally perform the sacrifice—this is not the Way of honoring teachers and valuing instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Now prefectural chiefs do not personally perform the sacrifice, which fails the Way of honoring teachers and valuing instruction.

sentences.zh: ”詔太常禮院檢討以聞。

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office to examine and report.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict ordered the Directorate of the Imperial Clan Ritual Office to examine the matter and report.

sentences.zh: 按《五禮精義》，州縣釋奠，刺史、縣令初獻，上佐、縣丞亞獻，州博士、縣主簿終獻。

translations.literal: According to the Essential Meaning of the Five Rites, for district and prefectural school sacrifices the prefect or magistrate served as primary offerer, the chief aide or assistant magistrate as secondary offerer, and the prefectural erudite or district registrar as final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Essential Meaning of the Five Rites, for district and prefectural school sacrifices the prefect or magistrate served as primary offerer, the chief aide or assistant magistrate as secondary offerer, and the prefectural erudite or district registrar as final offerer.

sentences.zh: 有故，以次官攝之。

translations.literal: If prevented, the next official in rank acted by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: If prevented, the next official in rank acted by proxy.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符三年，判國子監孫奭言：“上丁釋奠，舊禮以祭酒、司業、博士充三獻官，新禮以三公行事，近歲止命獻官兩員臨時通攝，未副崇祀向學之意。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Sun Shi, who was adjudicating the Imperial University, said: 'For the upper ding school sacrifice, the old rites used the libationer, vice director, and erudites as the three offering officials; the new rites had the three dukes perform the ceremonies. In recent years only two offering officials have been temporarily assigned to act in general proxy—this does not fulfill the intent of exalting sacrifice and encouraging learning.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Acting Superintendent Sun Shi said: 'For the upper ding school sacrifice, the old rites used the libationer, vice director, and erudites as the three offering officials; the new rites had the three chief ministers perform the ceremonies. In recent years only two offering officials have been temporarily assigned in proxy, which does not fulfill the intent of exalting sacrifice and encouraging learning.

sentences.zh: 望自今備差太尉、太常、光祿卿以充三獻。

translations.literal: We hope that from now on the Grand Commandant, Director of Sacrifices, and Director of Imperial Entertainments may be regularly assigned to serve as the three offerers.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that from now on the Grand Commandant, Director of Sacrifices, and Director of Imperial Entertainments be regularly assigned as the three offerers.

sentences.zh: ”又命崇文院刊《釋奠儀注》及《祭器圖》頒之諸路。

translations.literal: ' He also ordered the Palace Library to print the Regulations for School Sacrifice and Illustrations of Sacrificial Vessels and distribute them to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: ' He also ordered the Palace Library to print the Regulations for School Sacrifice and Illustrations of Sacrificial Vessels and distribute them to all circuits.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，國子監言：“舊例遇貢舉歲，禮部貢院集諸州府所貢第一人謁奠先聖，如春秋釋奠儀。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining, the Imperial University said: 'By former precedent, in years of the civil service examinations the Ministry of Rites examination compound gathered the top presented candidates from each prefecture and subprefecture to pay homage and offer sacrifice to the Former Sage, using the ritual of the spring and autumn school sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xining the Imperial University said: 'By former precedent, in examination years the Ministry of Rites examination compound gathered the top presented candidate from each prefecture and subprefecture to pay homage to the Former Sage using the spring and autumn school sacrifice ritual.

sentences.zh: 況春秋自有釋奠禮，請罷貢舉人謁奠。

translations.literal: Moreover, spring and autumn already have their own school sacrifice rites; we request that the examination candidates' homage sacrifice be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn already have their own school sacrifice rites; we ask that the examination candidates' homage sacrifice be abolished.

sentences.zh: ”崇寧，議禮局言：“太學獻官、太祝、奉禮，皆以法服，至於郡邑，則用常服。

translations.literal: ' In Chongning, the Bureau for Deliberating on Ritual said: 'At the Imperial College, offering officials, chief invokers, and ritual attendants all wear statutory robes, but in districts and prefectures they wear ordinary dress.
translations.idiomatic: ' In Chongning the Bureau for Deliberating on Ritual said: 'At the Imperial College, offering officials, chief invokers, and ritual attendants all wear statutory robes, but in districts and prefectures they wear ordinary dress.

sentences.zh: 望命有司降祭服於州縣，凡獻官、祝、禮，各服其服，以盡事神之儀。

translations.literal: We hope the authorities may issue sacrificial robes down to districts and prefectures so that all offering officials, invokers, and attendants each wear their proper robes and fully perform the rites of serving the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: We ask the authorities to issue sacrificial robes to districts and prefectures so that all offering officials, invokers, and attendants wear proper robes and fully perform the rites of serving the spirits.

sentences.zh: ”詔以衣服制度頒使州縣自造焉。

translations.literal: ' An edict promulgated the regulations for garments and ordered districts and prefectures to make them themselves.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict promulgated the garment regulations and ordered districts and prefectures to make them themselves.

sentences.zh: 其謁先師之禮：建隆二年，禮院準禮部貢院移，按《禮閣新儀》云：“舊儀無貢舉人謁先師之文。

translations.literal: The ritual for paying homage to the Former Teacher: In the second year of Jianlong, the Ritual Office followed a communication from the Ministry of Rites examination compound and, according to the New Regulations of the Ritual Pavilion, stated: 'The old regulations contain no text on examination candidates paying homage to the Former Teacher.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual for paying homage to the Former Teacher: In the second year of Jianlong the Ritual Office followed a communication from the Ministry of Rites examination compound and, according to the New Regulations of the Ritual Pavilion, stated: 'The old regulations contain no provision for examination candidates paying homage to the Former Teacher.

sentences.zh: 開元二十六年，詔諸州貢舉人見訖，就國子監謁先師，官為開講，質問疑義，所司設食。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Kaiyuan, an edict ordered that after the presented candidates of all prefectures had completed their audience, they proceed to the Imperial University to pay homage to the Former Teacher; officials opened lectures, questions were posed about doubtful points, and the responsible offices provided food.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Kaiyuan an edict ordered that after presented candidates from all prefectures had completed their audience, they proceed to the Imperial University to pay homage to the Former Teacher; officials opened lectures, doubtful points were discussed, and the responsible offices provided food.

sentences.zh: 昭文、崇文兩館學士及監內諸舉人亦準此。

translations.literal: Academicians of the Hall for the Exaltation of Literature and the Hall for the Veneration of Culture, as well as all candidates within the Directorate, followed this as well.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians of the Hall for the Exaltation of Literature and the Hall for the Veneration of Culture, as well as all candidates within the Directorate, followed this as well.

sentences.zh: ”自後諸州府貢舉人，十一月朔日正衙見訖，擇日謁先師，遂為常禮。

translations.literal: ' Thereafter, presented candidates from all prefectures and subprefectures, after completing their audience in the main court on the first day of the eleventh month, chose a day to pay homage to the Former Teacher, and this became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thereafter presented candidates from all prefectures and subprefectures, after completing their audience in the main court on the first day of the eleventh month, chose a day to pay homage to the Former Teacher, and this became regular practice.

sentences.zh: 大觀初，大司成強淵明言：“考之禮經，士始入學，有釋菜之儀。

translations.literal: Early in Daguan, the Grandee of Achievement Qiang Yuanming said: 'Examining the ritual classics, when scholars first enter school there is the ritual of vegetable offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Daguan the Grandee of Achievement Qiang Yuanming said: 'Examining the ritual classics, when scholars first enter school there is the ritual of vegetable offerings.

sentences.zh: 請自今每歲貢士始入辟雍，並以元日釋菜於先聖。

translations.literal: We request that from now on, each year when presented scholars first enter the Imperial Academy, they all perform vegetable offerings to the Former Sage on the first day of the year.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that from now on, each year when presented scholars first enter the Imperial Academy, they all perform vegetable offerings to the Former Sage on the first day of the year.

sentences.zh: ”其儀：獻官一員，以丞或博士；

translations.literal: ' The ritual: one offering official, drawn from an assistant director or erudite;
translations.idiomatic: ' The ritual: one offering official, drawn from an assistant director or erudite;

sentences.zh: 分奠官八員，以博士、正錄；

translations.literal: eight separate offering officials, drawn from erudites and chief recorders;
translations.idiomatic: eight separate offering officials, drawn from erudites and chief recorders;

sentences.zh: 大祝一員，以正錄。

translations.literal: one chief invoker, drawn from a chief recorder.
translations.idiomatic: one chief invoker, drawn from a chief recorder.

sentences.zh: 應祀官前釋菜一日赴學，各宿其次。

translations.literal: The officials participating in the sacrifice arrived at the school one day before the vegetable offering and each lodged at his assigned place.
translations.idiomatic: Officials participating in the sacrifice arrived at the school one day before the vegetable offering and each lodged at his assigned place.

sentences.zh: 至日，詣文宣王殿常服行禮，貢士初入學者陪位於庭，其他亦略仿釋奠之儀。

translations.literal: On the day, they proceeded to the hall of the Cultured and Propagating King in ordinary dress to perform the rites; presented scholars newly entering school stood in attendance in the courtyard, and the rest also roughly followed the ritual of the school sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day they proceeded to the Cultured and Propagating King hall in ordinary dress to perform the rites; newly enrolled presented scholars stood in attendance in the courtyard, and the rest roughly followed the school sacrifice ritual.

sentences.zh: 紹興十年，詔與大社、大稷並為大祀。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Shaoxing, an edict made it a major sacrifice together with the Great Altars of Earth and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Shaoxing an edict made it a major sacrifice together with the Great Altars of Earth and Grain.

sentences.zh: 淳熙四年，去王雱畫像。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunxi, the painted image of Wang Pang was removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chunxi the painted image of Wang Pang was removed.

sentences.zh: 淳祐元年正月，理宗幸太學，詔以周敦頤、張載、程顥、程頤、朱熹從祀，黜王安石。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Chunyou, Lizong visited the Imperial College and ordered that Zhou Dunyi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, Cheng Yi, and Zhu Xi receive collateral sacrifice and that Wang Anshi be removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Chunyou, Lizong visited the Imperial College and ordered that Zhou Dunyi, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, Cheng Yi, and Zhu Xi receive collateral sacrifice and that Wang Anshi be removed.

sentences.zh: 景定二年，皇太子詣學，請以張栻、呂祖謙從祀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingding, the crown prince visited the school and requested that Zhang Shi and Lü Zuqian receive collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingding the crown prince visited the school and requested that Zhang Shi and Lü Zuqian receive collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 鹹淳三年，詔封曾參郕國公，孔伋沂國公，配享先聖。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianchun, an edict enfeoffed Zeng Shen as Duke of Zeng and Kong Ji as Duke of Yi, with equal placement before the Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianchun an edict enfeoffed Zeng Shen as Duke of Zeng and Kong Ji as Duke of Yi, granting them equal placement before the Former Sage.

sentences.zh: 封顓孫師陳國公，升十哲位。

translations.literal: Zhuansun Shi was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen and elevated to a seat among the Ten Wise Ones.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuansun Shi was enfeoffed as Duke of Chen and elevated to a seat among the Ten Wise Ones.

sentences.zh: 復以邵雍、司馬光列從祀。

translations.literal: Shao Yong and Sima Guang were again listed for collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Yong and Sima Guang were again listed for collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其序：兗國公、郕國公、沂國公、鄒國公，居正位之東面，西向北上，為配位；

translations.literal: The order was: the Duke of Yan, the Duke of Zeng, the Duke of Yi, and the Duke of Zou occupied the eastern side of the main seat, facing west and ranking from north upward, as equal-placement seats;
translations.idiomatic: The order was: the Duke of Yan, the Duke of Zeng, the Duke of Yi, and the Duke of Zou occupied the eastern side of the main seat, facing west and ranking from north upward, as equal-placement seats;

sentences.zh: 費公閔損、薛公冉雍、黎公端木賜、衛公仲由、魏公卜商，居殿上東面，西向北上，鄆公冉耕、齊公宰予、徐公冉求、吳公言偃、陳公顓孫師，居殿上西面，東向北上，為從祀；

translations.literal: the Duke of Fei Min Sun, the Duke of Xue Ran Yong, the Duke of Li Duanmu Ci, the Duke of Wei Zhong You, and the Duke of Wei Bu Shang occupied the eastern side of the hall, facing west and ranking from north upward; the Duke of Yun Ran Geng, the Duke of Qi Zai Yu, the Duke of Xu Ran Qiu, the Duke of Wu Yan Yan, and the Duke of Chen Zhuansun Shi occupied the western side of the hall, facing east and ranking from north upward, as collateral sacrifices;
