sentences.zh: 昭烈武成王。

translations.literal: The Martial Achievement King of Illustrious Valor.
translations.idiomatic: The Martial Achievement King of Illustrious Valor.

sentences.zh: 自唐立太公廟，春秋仲月上戊日行祭禮。

translations.literal: From the Tang, a temple to the Grand Duke was established, and sacrifices were performed on the upper wu days of the second months of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tang a temple to the Grand Duke was established, with sacrifices performed on the upper wu days of the second months of spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 上元初，封為武成王，始置亞聖、十哲等，後又加七十二弟子。

translations.literal: Early in Shangyuan, he was enfeoffed as Martial Achievement King; the Second Sage, Ten Wise Ones, and others were first established, and later the seventy-two disciples were added.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shangyuan he was enfeoffed as Martial Achievement King; the Second Sage, Ten Wise Ones, and others were first established, and later the seventy-two disciples were added.

sentences.zh: 梁廢從祀之祭，後唐復之。

translations.literal: The Liang abolished collateral sacrifices; the Later Tang restored them.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang abolished collateral sacrifices; the Later Tang restored them.

sentences.zh: 太祖建隆三年，詔修武成王廟，與國學相對，命左諫議大夫崔頌董其役，仍令頌檢閱唐末以來謀臣、名將勳績尤著者以聞。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianlong, Taizu ordered the Martial Achievement King temple repaired, facing the National Academy, and appointed Left Remonstrance Counselor Cui Song to supervise the work, further ordering Song to review strategists and famous generals since the late Tang whose achievements were especially outstanding and report them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jianlong, Taizu ordered the Martial Achievement King temple repaired opposite the National Academy, appointed Left Remonstrance Counselor Cui Song to supervise the work, and directed him to review strategists and famous generals since the late Tang whose achievements were especially outstanding and report them.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，帝幸廟，曆觀圖壁，指白起曰：“此人殺已降，不武之甚，何受享於此？

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year, the emperor visited the temple, went through the painted walls, pointed to Bai Qi and said: 'This man slaughtered those who had already surrendered—an extreme lack of martial virtue. Why should he receive offerings here?
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fourth year the emperor visited the temple, went through the painted walls, pointed to Bai Qi and said: 'This man slaughtered men who had already surrendered—an extreme lack of martial virtue. Why should he receive offerings here?

sentences.zh: ”命去之。

translations.literal: ' He ordered him removed.
translations.idiomatic: ' He ordered him removed.

sentences.zh: 景德四年，詔西京擇地建廟，如東京製。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingde, an edict ordered that a site be chosen in the Western Capital to build a temple according to the Eastern Capital model.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jingde an edict ordered a site chosen in the Western Capital to build a temple according to the Eastern Capital model.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年，加諡昭烈。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the posthumous title Illustrious Valor was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu the posthumous title Illustrious Valor was added.

sentences.zh: 初，建隆議升曆代功臣二十三人，舊配享者退二十二人。

translations.literal: At first, in Jianlong it was proposed to elevate twenty-three meritorious officials of successive dynasties, and twenty-two of the former equal-placement figures were to be demoted.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in Jianlong it was proposed to elevate twenty-three meritorious officials of successive dynasties and demote twenty-two of the former equal-placement figures.

sentences.zh: 慶曆儀，自張良、管仲而下依舊配享，不用建隆升降之次。

translations.literal: Under the Qingli regulations, from Zhang Liang and Guan Zhong downward the old equal placement was retained, and the Jianlong promotions and demotions were not used.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qingli regulations, from Zhang Liang and Guan Zhong downward the old equal placement was retained, and the Jianlong promotions and demotions were not used.

sentences.zh: 元豐中，國子司業朱服言：“釋奠文宣王，以國子祭酒、司業為初獻，丞為亞獻，博士為終獻，太祝、奉禮並以監學官充。

translations.literal: During Yuanfeng, Zhu Fu, vice director of the Imperial University, said: 'For the school sacrifice to the Cultured and Propagating King, the libationer and vice director serve as primary and secondary offerers, the assistant director as final offerer, and the chief invoker and ritual attendant are both drawn from Directorate school officials.
translations.idiomatic: During Yuanfeng, Vice Director Zhu Fu said: 'For the school sacrifice to the Cultured and Propagating King, the libationer and vice director serve as primary and secondary offerers, the assistant director as final offerer, and the chief invoker and ritual attendant are both drawn from Directorate school officials.

sentences.zh: 及上戊釋奠武成王，以祭酒、司業為初獻，其亞獻、終獻及讀祝、捧幣，令三班院差使臣充之。

translations.literal: But for the upper wu sacrifice to the Martial Achievement King, the libationer and vice director serve as primary offerers, while the secondary and final offerers, the reading of the prayer, and the bearing of silks are assigned by the Three-Rank Bureau to dispatched commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: But for the upper wu sacrifice to the Martial Achievement King, the libationer and vice director serve as primary offerers, while the secondary and final offerers, the reading of the prayer, and the bearing of silks are assigned by the Three-Rank Bureau to dispatched commissioners.

sentences.zh: 官制未行，武學隸樞密院，學官員數少，故差右選。

translations.literal: Because the new bureaucratic system had not yet been implemented, the Military Academy was subordinate to the Bureau of Military Affairs and had few school officials, so right-selection officials were assigned.
translations.idiomatic: Because the new bureaucratic system had not yet been implemented, the Military Academy was subordinate to the Bureau of Military Affairs and had few school officials, so right-selection officials were assigned.

sentences.zh: 今武學隸國子監，長、貳、丞、簿，官屬已多，請並以本監官充攝行事，仍令太常寺修入《祀儀》。”

translations.literal: Now the Military Academy is subordinate to the Imperial University; its director, deputy, assistant director, and registrar and other officials are already numerous. We request that all ceremonies be performed by proxy through this Directorate's own officials, and that the Directorate of Sacrifices still be ordered to revise and enter this into the Sacrificial Regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Military Academy is subordinate to the Imperial University and already has numerous officials. We ask that all ceremonies be performed by this Directorate's own officials and that the Directorate of Sacrifices revise and enter this into the Sacrificial Regulations.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，武學諭張滋言：“《詩》雲‘赫赫南仲’、‘維師尚父’、‘文武吉甫’、‘顯允方叔’、‘王命召虎’、‘程伯休父’，是均為周將，功著聲詩，今昔所尊惟一尚父，而南仲、吉甫之徒不預配食，餘如卻縠之閱禮樂、敦詩書，尉繚以言為學者師法，不當棄而不錄，請並配食。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe, Zhang Zi, instructor at the Military Academy, said: 'The Odes say "Illustrious Nanzhong," "The master is the Grand Duke," "Wen and Wu, Jifu," "Illustrious and true, Fangshu," "The king commands Hu of Zhao," and "Cheng Bo Xiufu"—all were Zhou generals whose achievements are celebrated in the songs. Yet only the Grand Duke is honored past and present, while Nanzhong, Jifu, and the like are not granted sacrificial shares. Others such as Que He, who reviewed ritual and music and promoted the classics, and Wei Liao, whom scholars take as a model in speech, ought not to be abandoned unrecorded. We request that they all receive sacrificial shares.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenghe, Military Academy Instructor Zhang Zi said: 'The Odes celebrate Nanzhong, the Grand Duke, Jifu, Fangshu, Hu of Zhao, and Xiufu of Cheng—all Zhou generals whose achievements are sung in verse. Yet only the Grand Duke is honored past and present, while Nanzhong, Jifu, and the like lack sacrificial shares. Others such as Que He, who reviewed ritual and music and promoted the classics, and Wei Liao, whom scholars take as a model in speech, ought not be abandoned unrecorded. We ask that they all receive sacrificial shares.

sentences.zh: ”博士孫宗鑒亦請以黃石公配。

translations.literal: ' Erudite Sun Zongjian also requested that the Yellow Stone Elder receive equal placement.
translations.idiomatic: ' Erudite Sun Zongjian also requested that the Yellow Stone Elder receive equal placement.

sentences.zh: 後有司討論不定，國子監丞趙子崧復言之。

translations.literal: Later the responsible offices deliberated without reaching a decision, and Assistant Director of the Imperial University Zhao Zisong raised the matter again.
translations.idiomatic: Later the responsible offices deliberated without reaching a decision, and Assistant Director of the Imperial University Zhao Zisong raised the matter again.

sentences.zh: 宣和五年，禮部言：“武成王廟從祀，除本傳已有封爵者，其未經封爵之人，齊相管仲擬封涿水侯，大司馬田穰苴橫山侯，吳大將軍孫武滬瀆侯，越相范蠡遂武侯，燕將樂毅平虜侯，蜀丞相諸葛亮順興侯，魏西河守吳起封廣宗伯，齊將孫臏武清伯，田單昌平伯，趙將廉頗臨城伯，秦將王翦鎮山伯，漢前將軍李廣懷柔伯，吳將軍周瑜平虜伯。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuanhe, the Ministry of Rites said: 'For collateral sacrifice at the Martial Achievement King temple, apart from those who already have enfeoffments recorded in their biographies, those not yet enfeoffed were proposed as follows: the Qi chancellor Guan Zhong as Marquis of Zhuoshui, Grand Marshal Tian Rangju as Marquis of Hengshan, Wu grand general Sun Wu as Marquis of Hudu, Yue chancellor Fan Li as Marquis of Suiwu, Yan general Yue Yi as Marquis of Pinglu, Shu chancellor Zhuge Liang as Marquis of Shunxing, Wei defender of Xihe Wu Qi as Earl of Guangzong, Qi general Sun Bin as Earl of Wuqing, Tian Dan as Earl of Changping, Zhao general Lian Po as Earl of Lincheng, Qin general Wang Jian as Earl of Zhenshan, Han former general Li Guang as Earl of Huairou, and Wu general Zhou Yu as Earl of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuanhe the Ministry of Rites reported: 'For collateral sacrifice at the Martial Achievement King temple, apart from those already enfeoffed in their biographies, proposed enfeoffments were: Qi chancellor Guan Zhong as Marquis of Zhuoshui, Grand Marshal Tian Rangju as Marquis of Hengshan, Wu grand general Sun Wu as Marquis of Hudu, Yue chancellor Fan Li as Marquis of Suiwu, Yan general Yue Yi as Marquis of Pinglu, Shu chancellor Zhuge Liang as Marquis of Shunxing, Wei defender of Xihe Wu Qi as Earl of Guangzong, Qi general Sun Bin as Earl of Wuqing, Tian Dan as Earl of Changping, Zhao general Lian Po as Earl of Lincheng, Qin general Wang Jian as Earl of Zhenshan, Han former general Li Guang as Earl of Huairou, and Wu general Zhou Yu as Earl of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: ”於是釋奠日，以張良配享殿上，管仲、孫武、樂毅、諸葛亮、李勣並西向，田穰苴、范蠡、韓信、李靖、郭子儀並東向。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon on the day of the school sacrifice, Zhang Liang received equal placement in the main hall; Guan Zhong, Sun Wu, Yue Yi, Zhuge Liang, and Li Jie all faced west; Tian Rangju, Fan Li, Han Xin, Li Jing, and Guo Ziyi all faced east.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thereupon on the day of the school sacrifice, Zhang Liang received equal placement in the main hall; Guan Zhong, Sun Wu, Yue Yi, Zhuge Liang, and Li Jie all faced west; Tian Rangju, Fan Li, Han Xin, Li Jing, and Guo Ziyi all faced east.

sentences.zh: 東廡，白起、孫臏、廉頗、李牧、曹參、周勃、李廣、霍去病、鄧禹、馮異、吳漢、馬援、皇甫嵩、鄧艾、張飛、呂蒙、陸抗、杜預、陶侃、慕容恪、宇文憲、韋孝寬、楊素、賀若弼、李孝恭、蘇定方、王孝傑、王晙、李光弼，並西向；

translations.literal: in the eastern cloister, Bai Qi, Sun Bin, Lian Po, Li Mu, Cao Shen, Zhou Bo, Li Guang, Huo Qubing, Deng Yu, Feng Yi, Wu Han, Ma Yuan, Huangfu Song, Deng Ai, Zhang Fei, Lü Meng, Lu Kang, Du Yu, Tao Kan, Murong Ke, Yuwen Xian, Wei Xiaokuan, Yang Su, He Ruobi, Li Xiaogong, Su Dingfang, Wang Xiaojie, Wang Jun, and Li Guangbi all faced west;
translations.idiomatic: In the eastern cloister, Bai Qi, Sun Bin, Lian Po, Li Mu, Cao Shen, Zhou Bo, Li Guang, Huo Qubing, Deng Yu, Feng Yi, Wu Han, Ma Yuan, Huangfu Song, Deng Ai, Zhang Fei, Lü Meng, Lu Kang, Du Yu, Tao Kan, Murong Ke, Yuwen Xian, Wei Xiaokuan, Yang Su, He Ruobi, Li Xiaogong, Su Dingfang, Wang Xiaojie, Wang Jun, and Li Guangbi all faced west;

sentences.zh: 西廡，吳起、田單、趙奢、王翦、彭越、周亞夫、衛青、趙充國、寇恂、賈復、耿弇、段熲、張遼、關羽、周瑜、陸遜、羊祜、王濬、謝玄、王猛、王鎮惡、斛律光、王僧辯、於謹、吳明徹、韓擒虎、史萬歲、尉遲敬德、裴行儉、張仁亶、郭元振、李晟，並東向。

translations.literal: in the western cloister, Wu Qi, Tian Dan, Zhao She, Wang Jian, Peng Yue, Zhou Yafu, Wei Qing, Zhao Chongguo, Kou Xun, Jia Fu, Geng Yan, Duan Jiong, Zhang Liao, Guan Yu, Zhou Yu, Lu Xun, Yang Hu, Wang Jun, Xie Xuan, Wang Meng, Wang Zhen'e, Hulu Guang, Wang Sengbian, Yu Jin, Wu Mingche, Han Qinhu, Shi Wansui, Yuchi Jingde, Pei Xingjian, Zhang Renyuan, Guo Yuanzhen, and Li Sheng all faced east.
translations.idiomatic: in the western cloister, Wu Qi, Tian Dan, Zhao She, Wang Jian, Peng Yue, Zhou Yafu, Wei Qing, Zhao Chongguo, Kou Xun, Jia Fu, Geng Yan, Duan Jiong, Zhang Liao, Guan Yu, Zhou Yu, Lu Xun, Yang Hu, Wang Jun, Xie Xuan, Wang Meng, Wang Zhen'e, Hulu Guang, Wang Sengbian, Yu Jin, Wu Mingche, Han Qinhu, Shi Wansui, Yuchi Jingde, Pei Xingjian, Zhang Renyuan, Guo Yuanzhen, and Li Sheng all faced east.

sentences.zh: 凡七十二將雲。

translations.literal: In all, seventy-two generals.
translations.idiomatic: In all, seventy-two generals.

sentences.zh: 紹興七年五月，太常博士黃積厚乞以仲春、仲秋上戊日行禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year of Shaoxing, Erudite of the Directorate of Sacrifices Huang Jihou requested that the rites be performed on the upper wu days of the second months of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year of Shaoxing, Erudite of the Directorate of Sacrifices Huang Jihou requested that the rites be performed on the upper wu days of the second months of spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，國子監丞林保奏：“竊見昭烈武成王享以酒脯而不用牲牢，雖曰時方多事，禮用綿蕝，然非所以右武而勵將士也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, Assistant Director of the Imperial University Lin Bao memorialized: 'I observe that the Martial Achievement King of Illustrious Valor is offered wine and dried meat but not full sacrificial victims. Although it is said that the times were troubled and the rites used simple mats, this is not the way to honor martial virtue and encourage generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, Assistant Director Lin Bao memorialized: 'I observe that the Martial Achievement King of Illustrious Valor is offered wine and dried meat but not full sacrificial victims. Although the times were troubled and simple mats were used, this does not honor martial virtue and encourage generals and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 乞今後上戊釋奠用牲牢，以管仲至郭子儀十八人祀於殿上。

translations.literal: We request that hereafter the upper wu school sacrifice use full victims, and that the eighteen from Guan Zhong to Guo Ziyi be sacrificed to in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that hereafter the upper wu school sacrifice use full victims and that the eighteen from Guan Zhong to Guo Ziyi be sacrificed to in the main hall.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ' The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: ' The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年，詔武成王廟升李晟於堂上，降李勣於李晟位次，仍以曹彬從祀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiandao, an edict ordered that at the Martial Achievement King temple Li Sheng be elevated to the main hall, Li Jie demoted to rank after Li Sheng, and Cao Bin still given collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Qiandao an edict ordered that at the Martial Achievement King temple Li Sheng be elevated to the main hall, Li Jie demoted to rank after Li Sheng, and Cao Bin still given collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 先是，紹興間，右正言都民望言：“李勣邪說誤國，唐祀幾滅，李晟有再造王室之勳；

translations.literal: Earlier, during Shaoxing, Right Remonstrance Counselor Du Minwang said: 'Li Jie's heterodox doctrines misled the state and Tang sacrifices nearly perished, whereas Li Sheng had the achievement of restoring the royal house;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during Shaoxing, Right Remonstrance Counselor Du Minwang said: 'Li Jie's heterodox doctrines misled the state and Tang sacrifices nearly perished, whereas Li Sheng restored the royal house;

sentences.zh: 宜升李晟於堂上，置李勣於河間王孝恭之下。

translations.literal: Li Sheng ought to be elevated to the main hall and Li Jie placed below the Prince of Hejian, Li Xiaogong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sheng ought to be elevated to the main hall and Li Jie placed below the Prince of Hejian, Li Xiaogong.

sentences.zh: ”至是，著作郎傅伯壽言：“武成廟從祀，出於唐開元間，一時銓次，失於太雜。

translations.literal: ' At this point, Compiler Fu Boshou said: 'Collateral sacrifice at the Martial Achievement temple originated in the Kaiyuan era of Tang; the ranking of that time was done all at once and erred on the side of excessive variety.
translations.idiomatic: ' At this point, Compiler Fu Boshou said: 'Collateral sacrifice at the Martial Achievement temple originated in the Tang Kaiyuan era; the ranking of that time was done all at once and erred on excessive variety.

sentences.zh: 如尹吉甫之伐玁狁，召虎之平淮夷，寔亞鷹揚之烈；

translations.literal: Men such as Yin Jifu, who campaigned against the Xianyun, and Hu of Zhao, who pacified the Huaiyi, in truth rank just below the soaring hawk's martial glory;
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Yin Jifu, who campaigned against the Xianyun, and Hu of Zhao, who pacified the Huaiyi, in truth rank just below the soaring hawk's martial glory;

sentences.zh: 陳湯、傅介子、馮奉世、班超之流，皆為有漢之雋功；

translations.literal: Chen Tang, Fu Jiezi, Feng Fengshi, Ban Chao, and the like all performed outstanding achievements for Han;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tang, Fu Jiezi, Feng Fengshi, Ban Chao, and the like all performed outstanding achievements for Han;

sentences.zh: 在晉則謝安、祖逖，在唐則王忠嗣、張巡輩，皆不得預從祀之列。

translations.literal: in Jin there were Xie An and Zu Ti; in Tang there were Wang Zhongsi, Zhang Xun, and the like—all unable to enter the ranks of collateral sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: in Jin there were Xie An and Zu Ti; in Tang there were Wang Zhongsi, Zhang Xun, and the like—all unable to enter the ranks of collateral sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 竊聞邇日議臣請以本朝名將從祀，謂宜並詔有司，討論曆代諸將，為之去取，然後與本朝名將，繪於殿廡，亦乞取建隆、建炎以來驍俊忠概之臣，功烈暴於天下者，參陪廟祀。

translations.literal: I have heard that recently deliberating officials requested that famous generals of this dynasty receive collateral sacrifice. They hold that the authorities ought simultaneously to be ordered to deliberate on generals of successive dynasties and make selections, and then together with famous generals of this dynasty paint them in the hall cloisters. I also request that from Jianlong and Jianyan onward, fierce and loyal ministers whose achievements were manifest throughout the realm be admitted to participate in temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that recently deliberating officials requested that famous generals of this dynasty receive collateral sacrifice. They hold that the authorities ought simultaneously deliberate on generals of successive dynasties and make selections, then together with famous generals of this dynasty paint them in the hall cloisters. I also ask that from Jianlong and Jianyan onward, fierce and loyal ministers whose achievements were manifest throughout the realm be admitted to temple sacrifices.

sentences.zh: ”故有是命。

translations.literal: ' Hence this edict.
translations.idiomatic: ' Hence this edict.

sentences.zh: 先代陵廟及錄名臣後。

translations.literal: Ancestral Mausoleum Temples and Recording the Descendants of Famous Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestral Mausoleum Temples and Recording the Descendants of Famous Ministers.

sentences.zh: 建隆元年，詔：“前代帝王陵寢、忠臣賢士丘壟，或樵采不禁、風雨不芘，宜以郡國置戶以守，隳毀者修葺之。”

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianlong, an edict stated: 'The mausoleums of former dynasties' emperors and the mounds of loyal ministers and worthy scholars—where firewood gathering is not forbidden or wind and rain go unshielded—it is fitting that prefectures and commanderies assign households to guard them, and what has been damaged should be repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jianlong an edict stated: 'The mausoleums of former emperors and the mounds of loyal ministers and worthy scholars—where firewood gathering is not forbidden or wind and rain go unshielded—prefectures and commanderies should assign households to guard them, and damaged sites should be repaired.

sentences.zh: 乾德初，詔：“曆代帝王，國有常享，著於甲令，可舉而行。

translations.literal: Early in Qiande, an edict stated: 'Emperors of successive dynasties have regular state sacrifices recorded in statutory commands, which may be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qiande an edict stated: 'Emperors of successive dynasties have regular state sacrifices recorded in statutory commands, which may be carried out.

sentences.zh: 自五代亂離，百司廢墜，匱神乏祀，闕孰甚焉。

translations.literal: Since the turmoil and separation of the Five Dynasties, the hundred offices have fallen into ruin, spirits lack offerings, and no gap is greater.
translations.idiomatic: Since the turmoil of the Five Dynasties, the hundred offices have fallen into ruin, spirits lack offerings, and no gap is greater.

sentences.zh: 按《祠令》，先代帝王，每三年一享，以仲春之月，牲用太牢，祀官以本州長官，有故則上佐行事。

translations.literal: According to the Shrine Regulations, former dynasties' emperors receive a sacrifice every three years in the second month of spring, with victims of the grand pen, the sacrificing official being the chief officer of the prefecture, and if prevented the chief aide performing the rites.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Shrine Regulations, former emperors receive a sacrifice every three years in the second month of spring, with grand-pen victims, the prefect serving as sacrificing official, and if prevented the chief aide performing the rites.

sentences.zh: 官造祭器，送諸陵廟。

translations.literal: Officials manufacture sacrificial vessels and send them to the various mausoleum temples.
translations.idiomatic: Officials manufacture sacrificial vessels and send them to the various mausoleum temples.

sentences.zh: ”又詔：“先代帝王，載在祀典，或廟貌猶在，久廢牲牢，或陵墓雖存，不禁樵采。

translations.literal: ' Another edict stated: 'Former dynasties' emperors recorded in the sacrificial canon—some still have temple images standing but have long abandoned full victims, and some mausoleums still exist but do not forbid firewood gathering.
translations.idiomatic: ' Another edict stated: 'Former emperors recorded in the sacrificial canon—some still have temple images standing but have long abandoned full victims, and some mausoleums still exist but do not forbid firewood gathering.

sentences.zh: 其太昊、炎帝、黃帝、高辛、唐堯、虞舜、夏禹、成湯、周文王武王、漢高帝光武、唐高祖太宗，各置守陵五戶，歲春秋祠以太牢；

translations.literal: For Taihao, Yandi, the Yellow Emperor, Gaoxin, Tang Yao, Yu Shun, Yu of Xia, Cheng Tang, King Wen and King Wu of Zhou, Gaozu and Guangwu of Han, and Gaozu and Taizong of Tang, five households guarding each mausoleum were assigned, with spring and autumn sacrifices using the grand pen;
translations.idiomatic: For Taihao, Yandi, the Yellow Emperor, Gaoxin, Tang Yao, Yu Shun, Yu of Xia, Cheng Tang, King Wen and King Wu of Zhou, Gaozu and Guangwu of Han, and Gaozu and Taizong of Tang, five households guarding each mausoleum were assigned, with spring and autumn sacrifices using the grand pen;

sentences.zh: 商中宗太戊高宗武丁、周成王康王、漢文帝宣帝、魏太祖、晉武帝、後周太祖、隋高祖，各置三戶，歲一享以太牢；

translations.literal: for Zhongzong, Taiwu, Gaozong, and Wuding of Shang; King Cheng and King Kang of Zhou; Emperor Wen and Emperor Xuan of Han; the Taizu of Wei; Emperor Wu of Jin; the Taizu of Later Zhou; and Gaozu of Sui, three households each were assigned, with one annual sacrifice using the grand pen;
translations.idiomatic: for Zhongzong, Taiwu, Gaozong, and Wuding of Shang; King Cheng and King Kang of Zhou; Emperor Wen and Emperor Xuan of Han; the Taizu of Wei; Emperor Wu of Jin; the Taizu of Later Zhou; and Gaozu of Sui, three households each were assigned, with one annual sacrifice using the grand pen;

sentences.zh: 秦始皇帝、漢景帝武帝明帝章帝、魏文帝、後魏孝文帝、唐玄宗憲宗肅宗宣宗、梁太祖、後唐莊宗明宗、晉高祖，各置守陵兩戶，三年一祭以太牢；

translations.literal: for the First Emperor of Qin; Emperor Jing, Emperor Wu, Emperor Ming, and Emperor Zhang of Han; Emperor Wen of Wei; Emperor Xiaowen of Later Wei; Emperor Xuanzong, Xianzong, Suzong, and Xuanzong of Tang; the Taizu of Liang; Zhuangzong and Mingzong of Later Tang; and Gaozu of Jin, two households guarding each mausoleum were assigned, with sacrifices every three years using the grand pen;
translations.idiomatic: for the First Emperor of Qin; Emperor Jing, Emperor Wu, Emperor Ming, and Emperor Zhang of Han; Emperor Wen of Wei; Emperor Xiaowen of Later Wei; Emperor Xuanzong, Xianzong, Suzong, and Xuanzong of Tang; the Taizu of Liang; Zhuangzong and Mingzong of Later Tang; and Gaozu of Jin, two households guarding each mausoleum were assigned, with sacrifices every three years using the grand pen;

sentences.zh: 周桓王景王威烈王、漢元帝成帝哀帝平帝和帝殤帝安帝順帝衝帝質帝獻帝、魏明帝高貴鄉公陳留王、晉惠帝懷帝湣帝、西魏文帝、東魏孝靜帝、唐高宗中宗睿宗德宗順宗穆宗代宗敬宗文宗武宗懿宗僖宗昭宗、梁少帝、後唐末帝諸陵，常禁樵采。

translations.literal: the mausoleums of King Huan, King Jing, and King Weilie of Zhou; Emperor Yuan, Emperor Cheng, Emperor Ai, Emperor Ping, Emperor He, Emperor Shang, Emperor An, Emperor Shun, Emperor Chong, Emperor Zhi, and Emperor Xian of Han; Emperor Ming of Wei, the Duke of Gaoguixiang, and the King of Chenliu; Emperor Hui, Emperor Huai, and Emperor Min of Jin; Emperor Wen of Western Wei; Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei; Emperor Gaozong, Zhongzong, Ruizong, Dezong, Shunzong, Muzong, Daizong, Jingzong, Wenzong, Wuzong, Yizong, Xizong, and Zhaozong of Tang; the Young Emperor of Liang; and the Last Emperor of Later Tang were permanently to forbid firewood gathering.
translations.idiomatic: the mausoleums of King Huan, King Jing, and King Weilie of Zhou; Emperor Yuan through Emperor Xian of Han; Emperor Ming of Wei, the Duke of Gaoguixiang, and the King of Chenliu; Emperor Hui, Emperor Huai, and Emperor Min of Jin; Emperor Wen of Western Wei; Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei; Emperor Gaozong through Emperor Zhaozong of Tang; the Young Emperor of Liang; and the Last Emperor of Later Tang permanently forbade firewood gathering.

sentences.zh: ”尋又禁河南府民耕晉、漢廟壖地。

translations.literal: ' Shortly thereafter, farming by the people of Henan Prefecture on the temple-border lands of the Jin and Han was also forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: ' Shortly thereafter farming by the people of Henan Prefecture on the temple-border lands of Jin and Han was also forbidden.

sentences.zh: 凡諸陵有經開發者，有司造袞冕服、常服各一襲，具棺槨以葬，掩坎日，所在長吏致祭。

translations.literal: Whenever any mausoleum was opened by excavation, the responsible offices made one set each of ceremonial robes and coronets and ordinary dress, provided coffin and inner coffin for burial, and on the day the grave was closed the local chief officer performed sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever any mausoleum was opened by excavation, the responsible offices made one set each of ceremonial robes and ordinary dress, provided coffin and inner coffin for burial, and on the day the grave was closed the local chief officer performed sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 又詔前代功臣、烈士，詳其勳業優劣以聞。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that meritorious officials and martyrs of former dynasties have their achievements examined in detail for superiority or inferiority and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that meritorious officials and martyrs of former dynasties have their achievements examined in detail and reported.

sentences.zh: 有司言：“齊孫臏晏嬰、晉程嬰公孫杵臼、燕樂毅、漢曹參陳平韓信周亞夫衛青霍去病霍光、蜀昭烈帝關羽張飛諸葛亮、唐房玄齡長孫無忌魏征李靖李勣尉遲恭渾瑊段秀實等，皆勳德高邁，為當時之冠；

translations.literal: The responsible offices said: 'Qi's Sun Bin and Yan Ying; Jin's Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu; Yan's Yue Yi; Han's Cao Shen, Chen Ping, Han Xin, Zhou Yafu, Wei Qing, Huo Qubing, and Huo Guang; Shu's Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang; and Tang's Fang Xuanling, Zhangsun Wuji, Wei Zheng, Li Jing, Li Jie, Yuchi Gong, Hun Jian, and Duan Xiushi—all had lofty merit and virtue and were foremost in their times;
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices said: 'Qi's Sun Bin and Yan Ying; Jin's Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu; Yan's Yue Yi; Han's Cao Shen, Chen Ping, Han Xin, Zhou Yafu, Wei Qing, Huo Qubing, and Huo Guang; Shu's Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang; and Tang's Fang Xuanling, Zhangsun Wuji, Wei Zheng, Li Jing, Li Jie, Yuchi Gong, Hun Jian, and Duan Xiushi—all had lofty merit and virtue and were foremost in their times;

sentences.zh: 晉趙簡子、齊孟嚐君、趙趙奢、漢邴吉、唐高士廉唐儉岑文本馬周為之次；

translations.literal: Jin's Zhao Jianzi, Qi's Lord Mengchang, Zhao's Zhao She, Han's Bing Ji, and Tang's Gao Shilian, Tang Jian, Cen Wende, and Ma Zhou ranked next;
translations.idiomatic: Jin's Zhao Jianzi, Qi's Lord Mengchang, Zhao's Zhao She, Han's Bing Ji, and Tang's Gao Shilian, Tang Jian, Cen Wende, and Ma Zhou ranked next;

sentences.zh: 南燕慕容德、唐裴寂、元稹又次之。

translations.literal: Southern Yan's Murong De, Tang's Pei Ji, and Yuan Zhen ranked still lower.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yan's Murong De, Tang's Pei Ji, and Yuan Zhen ranked still lower.

sentences.zh: ”詔孫臏等各置守塚三戶，趙簡子等各二戶，慕容德等禁樵采；

translations.literal: ' An edict ordered three households guarding the tombs for Sun Bin and the like, two households each for Zhao Jianzi and the like, and firewood gathering forbidden for Murong De and the like;
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict ordered three households guarding the tombs for Sun Bin and the like, two households each for Zhao Jianzi and the like, and firewood gathering forbidden for Murong De and the like;

sentences.zh: 其有開毀者，皆具棺槨、朝服以葬，掩坎日致祭，長吏奉行其事。

translations.literal: wherever tombs were opened or damaged, coffin and inner coffin and court dress were all provided for burial, sacrifice was performed on the day the grave was closed, and the chief local officer carried out the matter.
translations.idiomatic: wherever tombs were opened or damaged, coffin, inner coffin, and court dress were provided for burial, sacrifice was performed on the day the grave was closed, and the chief local officer carried out the matter.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年，從知濮州韓鐸請：“堯陵在雷澤縣東穀林山，陵南有堯母慶都靈台廟，請敕本州春秋致祭，置守陵五戶，免其租，奉灑掃。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, following the request of Han Duo, acting prefect of Puzhou: 'Yao's mausoleum is on Gulin Mountain east of Leize County; south of the mausoleum is the Spirit Terrace Temple of Yao's mother Qingdu. We request that this prefecture be ordered to perform spring and autumn sacrifices, assign five households to guard the mausoleum, exempt their rents, and maintain sweeping and sprinkling.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xining, following the request of Acting Prefect Han Duo of Puzhou: 'Yao's mausoleum is on Gulin Mountain east of Leize County; south of the mausoleum is the Spirit Terrace Temple of Yao's mother Qingdu. We ask that this prefecture be ordered to perform spring and autumn sacrifices, assign five households to guard the mausoleum, exempt their rents, and maintain sweeping and sprinkling.

sentences.zh: ”又以中丞鄧潤甫言，唐諸陵陵已定頃畝外，其餘許耕佃為守陵戶，餘並禁止。

translations.literal: ' Following Censor Deng Runfu's statement, beyond the fixed acreage of Tang mausoleums, the remainder was permitted to be farmed and leased by mausoleum-guard households; all else was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: ' Following Censor Deng Runfu's statement, beyond the fixed acreage of Tang mausoleums, the remainder was permitted to be farmed and leased by mausoleum-guard households; all else was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 先是，仁宗嚐錄唐張九齡九代孫錫，狄仁傑裔孫國寶，郭子儀孫元亨，長孫無忌孫宏，皆命以官。

translations.literal: Earlier, Renzong had enrolled Tang Zhang Jiuling's ninth-generation descendant Xi, Di Renjie's descendant Guobao, Guo Ziyi's grandson Yuanheng, and Zhangsun Wuji's grandson Hong, all ordering them given office.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Renzong had enrolled Tang Zhang Jiuling's ninth-generation descendant Xi, Di Renjie's descendant Guobao, Guo Ziyi's grandson Yuanheng, and Zhangsun Wuji's grandson Hong, all ordering them given office.

sentences.zh: 神宗又錄魏征孫道嚴，段秀實十二世孫昊、八世孫文酉，仍復其家。

translations.literal: Shenzong further enrolled Wei Zheng's grandson Daoyan, Duan Xiushi's twelfth-generation descendant Hao and eighth-generation descendant Wenyou, and restored their families.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong further enrolled Wei Zheng's grandson Daoyan, Duan Xiushi's twelfth-generation descendant Hao and eighth-generation descendant Wenyou, and restored their families.

sentences.zh: 元祐六年，詔相州商王河亶甲塚、沂州費縣顏真卿墓並載祀典。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanyou, an edict ordered that the mound of He Dan, King of Shang of Heyi in Xiangzhou, and the tomb of Yan Zhenqing in Fei County, Yizhou, both be entered in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanyou an edict ordered that the mound of He Dan, King of Shang of Heyi in Xiangzhou, and the tomb of Yan Zhenqing in Fei County, Yizhou, both be entered in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 先是，乾德中，定先代帝王配享儀，下諸州以時薦祭，牲用羊、豕，政和議禮局遂為定制。

translations.literal: Earlier, in Qiande, the ritual for equal placement sacrifices to former emperors was fixed, sent down to the prefectures for timely offerings, with victims of sheep and swine; the Bureau for Deliberating on Ritual in Zhenghe then made this the established regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Qiande, the ritual for sacrifices to former emperors was fixed, sent down to the prefectures for timely offerings, with sheep and swine as victims; the Bureau for Deliberating on Ritual in Zhenghe then made this the established regulation.

sentences.zh: 初，紹興二年，駕部員外郎李願奏：“程嬰、公孫杵臼於趙最為功臣，神宗皇嗣未建，封嬰為成信侯，杵臼為忠智侯，命絳州立廟，歲時奉祀，其後皇嗣眾多。

translations.literal: At first, in the second year of Shaoxing, Li Yuan, outer official of the Transport Office, memorialized: 'Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu were Zhao's greatest meritorious subjects. When Shenzong's imperial heir had not yet been established, Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chengxin and Chujiu as Marquis of Zhongzhi, and Jiangzhou was ordered to erect a temple with seasonal sacrifices. Thereafter imperial heirs became numerous.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in the second year of Shaoxing, Li Yuan of the Transport Office memorialized: 'Cheng Ying and Gongsun Chujiu were Zhao's greatest meritorious subjects. When Shenzong's imperial heir had not yet been established, Ying was enfeoffed as Marquis of Chengxin and Chujiu as Marquis of Zhongzhi, and Jiangzhou was ordered to erect a temple with seasonal sacrifices. Thereafter imperial heirs became numerous.

sentences.zh: 今廟宇隔絕，祭亦弗舉，宜於行在所設位望祭。

translations.literal: Now the temple is cut off and sacrifices are no longer performed; it is fitting to set up seats at the traveling court and perform distant sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Now the temple is cut off and sacrifices are no longer performed; it is fitting to set up seats at the traveling court and perform distant sacrifices.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ' The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: ' The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十一年，中書舍人朱翌言：“謹按晉國屠岸賈之亂，韓厥正言以拒之，而嬰、杵臼皆以死匿其孤，卒立趙武，而趙祀不絕，厥之功也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Secretariat Drafter Zhu Yi said: 'Carefully examining the turmoil of Tuo'an Jia in Jin, Han Jue spoke uprightly to resist him, while Ying and Chujiu both died hiding the orphan, ultimately establishing Zhao Wu so that Zhao sacrifices did not cease—this was Jue's achievement.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Secretariat Drafter Zhu Yi said: 'Carefully examining the turmoil of Tuo'an Jia in Jin, Han Jue spoke uprightly to resist him, while Ying and Chujiu both died hiding the orphan, ultimately establishing Zhao Wu so that Zhao sacrifices did not cease—this was Jue's achievement.

sentences.zh: 宜載之祀典，與嬰、杵臼並享春秋之祀，亦足為忠義無窮之勸。

translations.literal: He ought to be entered in the sacrificial canon and share spring and autumn sacrifices with Ying and Chujiu—this would also suffice as an endless encouragement to loyalty and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: He ought to be entered in the sacrificial canon and share spring and autumn sacrifices with Ying and Chujiu—this would also suffice as an endless encouragement to loyalty and righteousness.

sentences.zh: ”禮寺亦言：“崇寧間已封厥義成侯，今宜依舊立祚德廟致祭。

translations.literal: ' The Ritual Office also said: 'During Chongning, Jue was already enfeoffed as Marquis of Yicheng; now it is fitting to establish the Blessing-and-Virtue Temple as before and perform sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: ' The Ritual Office also said: 'During Chongning, Jue was already enfeoffed as Marquis of Yicheng; now it is fitting to establish the Blessing-and-Virtue Temple as before and perform sacrifices.

sentences.zh: ”十六年，加嬰忠節成信侯，杵臼通勇忠智侯，厥忠定義成侯。

translations.literal: ' In the sixteenth year, Ying was further titled Marquis of Chengxin of Loyal Integrity, Chujiu Marquis of Zhongzhi of Universal Courage, and Jue Marquis of Yicheng of Loyal Determination.
translations.idiomatic: ' In the sixteenth year, Ying was further titled Marquis of Chengxin of Loyal Integrity, Chujiu Marquis of Zhongzhi of Universal Courage, and Jue Marquis of Yicheng of Loyal Determination.

sentences.zh: 後改封嬰疆濟公，杵臼英略公，厥啟侑公，升為中祀。

translations.literal: Later Ying was changed to Duke of Jiangji, Chujiu to Duke of Yinglue, and Jue to Duke of Qiyou, and they were elevated to secondary sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Later Ying was changed to Duke of Jiangji, Chujiu to Duke of Yinglue, and Jue to Duke of Qiyou, and they were elevated to secondary sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 諸祠廟。

translations.literal: Various Shrines and Temples.
translations.idiomatic: Various Shrines and Temples.

sentences.zh: 自開寶、皇祐以來，凡天下名在地誌，功及生民，宮觀陵廟，名山大川能興雲雨者，並加崇飾，增入祀典。

translations.literal: From Kaibao and Huangyou onward, all places in the realm whose names were in local gazetteers, whose achievements reached the living people, palaces and temples and mausoleum temples, and famous mountains and great rivers able to raise clouds and rain were all given enhanced adornment and added to the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: From Kaibao and Huangyou onward, all places in the realm whose names were in local gazetteers, whose achievements reached the living people, palaces and temples and mausoleum temples, and famous mountains and great rivers able to raise clouds and rain were all given enhanced adornment and added to the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 熙寧復詔應祠廟祈禱靈驗，而未有爵號，並以名聞。

translations.literal: In Xining another edict ordered that shrines and temples responding to prayers with spiritual efficacy but lacking noble titles all report by name.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining another edict ordered that shrines and temples responding to prayers with spiritual efficacy but lacking noble titles all report by name.

sentences.zh: 於是太常博士王古請：“自今諸神祠無爵號者賜廟額，已賜額者加封爵，初封侯，再封公，次封王，生有爵位者從其本封。

translations.literal: Thereupon Erudite of the Directorate of Sacrifices Wang Gu requested: 'From now on, spirit shrines without noble titles should be granted temple name plaques; those already granted plaques should receive additional enfeoffments—first marquis, then duke, then king; those who held titles in life follow their original enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Erudite Wang Gu of the Directorate of Sacrifices requested: 'From now on, spirit shrines without noble titles should be granted temple name plaques; those already granted plaques should receive additional enfeoffments—first marquis, then duke, then king; those who held titles in life follow their original enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 婦人之神封夫人，再封妃。

translations.literal: Female spirits are enfeoffed as Lady, and upon further enfeoffment as Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Female spirits are enfeoffed as Lady, and upon further enfeoffment as Consort.

sentences.zh: 其封號者初二字，再加四字。

translations.literal: Their enfeoffment titles begin with two characters and upon addition receive four more.
translations.idiomatic: Their enfeoffment titles begin with two characters and upon addition receive four more.

sentences.zh: 如此，則錫命馭神，恩禮有序。

translations.literal: In this way, bestowing commands would govern the spirits and favor and ritual would be ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In this way, bestowed commands would govern the spirits and favor and ritual would be properly ordered.

sentences.zh: 欲更增神仙封號，初真人，次真君。

translations.literal: For immortal spirits additional enfeoffment titles were desired: first Perfected Person, then Perfected Lord.
translations.idiomatic: For immortal spirits additional titles were proposed: first Perfected Person, then Perfected Lord.

sentences.zh: ”大觀中，尚書省言，神祠加封爵等，未有定制，乃並給告、賜額、降敕。

translations.literal: ' During Daguan, the Secretariat said that adding enfeoffments and the like to spirit shrines had no established regulation, and so proclamations, granted name plaques, and issued edicts were all given together.
translations.idiomatic: ' During Daguan the Secretariat reported that adding enfeoffments to spirit shrines had no established regulation, so proclamations, granted name plaques, and issued edicts were all given together.

sentences.zh: 已而詔開封府毀神祠一千三十八區，遷其像入寺觀及本廟，仍禁軍民擅立大小祠。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter an edict ordered Kaifeng Prefecture to destroy one thousand thirty-eight spirit shrines, move their images into monasteries and their original temples, and still forbid soldiers and civilians from erecting large or small shrines on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter an edict ordered Kaifeng Prefecture to destroy one thousand thirty-eight spirit shrines, move their images into monasteries and original temples, and forbid soldiers and civilians from erecting shrines on their own authority.

sentences.zh: 秘書監何誌同言：“諸州祠廟多有封爵未正之處，如屈原廟，在歸州者封清烈公，在潭州者封忠潔侯。

translations.literal: Director of the Palace Library He Zhitong said: 'In the shrines and temples of the various prefectures there are many places where enfeoffments have not been corrected. For example, Qu Yuan's temple is enfeoffed as Duke of Qinglie in Guizhou and as Marquis of Zhongjie in Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Palace Library He Zhitong said: 'In shrines and temples throughout the prefectures many enfeoffments remain uncorrected. For example, Qu Yuan's temple is enfeoffed as Duke of Qinglie in Guizhou and as Marquis of Zhongjie in Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 永康軍李冰廟，已封廣濟王，近乃封靈應公。

translations.literal: The Li Bing temple in Yongkang Commandery had already been enfeoffed as King of Guangji, but recently was enfeoffed as Duke of Lingying.
translations.idiomatic: The Li Bing temple in Yongkang Commandery had already been enfeoffed as King of Guangji, but was recently enfeoffed as Duke of Lingying.

sentences.zh: 如此之類，皆未有祀典，致前後差誤。

translations.literal: Cases of this sort all lacked entry in the sacrificial canon, causing errors between earlier and later periods.
translations.idiomatic: Cases of this sort all lacked entry in the sacrificial canon, causing inconsistencies over time.

sentences.zh: 宜加稽考，取一高爵為定，悉改正之。

translations.literal: It is fitting to add examination and verification, take the highest enfeoffment as the standard, and correct them all.
translations.idiomatic: They should be examined and verified, the highest enfeoffment taken as the standard, and all corrected accordingly.

sentences.zh: 他皆仿此。

translations.literal: All others should follow this model.
translations.idiomatic: All others should follow this model.

sentences.zh: ”故凡祠廟賜額、封號，多在熙寧、元祐、崇寧、宣和之時。

translations.literal: ' Hence the granting of name plaques and enfeoffment titles to shrines and temples occurred mostly during Xining, Yuanyou, Chongning, and Xuanhe.
translations.idiomatic: ' Hence the granting of name plaques and enfeoffment titles to shrines and temples occurred mostly during Xining, Yuanyou, Chongning, and Xuanhe.

sentences.zh: 其新立廟：若何承矩、李允則守雄州，曹瑋帥秦州，李繼和節度鎮戎軍，則以有功一方者也。

translations.literal: Among newly established temples: He Chengjü and Li Yunze, who defended Xiongzhou; Cao Wei, who commanded Qinzhou; and Li Jihe, who governed Zhenrong Army—all were enshrined for meritorious service in a region.
translations.idiomatic: Among newly established temples: He Chengjü and Li Yunze, who defended Xiongzhou; Cao Wei, who commanded Qinzhou; and Li Jihe, who governed Zhenrong Army—all were enshrined for meritorious service in a region.

sentences.zh: 韓琦在中山，範仲淹在慶州，孫冕在海州，則以政有威惠者也。

translations.literal: Han Qi in Zhongshan, Fan Zhongyan in Qingzhou, and Sun Mian in Haizhou were enshrined because their governance had authority and kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi in Zhongshan, Fan Zhongyan in Qingzhou, and Sun Mian in Haizhou were enshrined because their governance combined authority and kindness.

sentences.zh: 王承偉築祁州河堤，工部員外郎張夏築錢塘江岸，則以為人除患者也。

translations.literal: Wang Chengwei, who built the Qizhou river embankment, and Zhang Xia of the Ministry of Works, who built the Qiantang River bank, were enshrined for removing harm from the people.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengwei, who built the Qizhou river embankment, and Zhang Xia of the Ministry of Works, who built the Qiantang River bank, were enshrined for removing harm from the people.

sentences.zh: 封州曹覲、德慶府趙師旦、邕州蘇緘、恩州通判董元亨、指揮使馬遂，則死於亂賊者也。

translations.literal: Cao Jing of Fengzhou, Zhao Shidan of Deqing Prefecture, Su Jian of Yongzhou, Enzhou vice prefect Dong Yuanheng, and Commandant Ma Sui were enshrined for dying at the hands of rebellious bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Jing of Fengzhou, Zhao Shidan of Deqing Prefecture, Su Jian of Yongzhou, Enzhou vice prefect Dong Yuanheng, and Commandant Ma Sui were enshrined for dying at the hands of rebellious bandits.

sentences.zh: 其王韶於熙河，李憲於蘭州，劉氵扈於水洛城，郭成於懷慶軍，折禦卿於嵐州，作坊使王吉於麟州神堂砦，各以功業建廟。

translations.literal: Wang Shao at Xihe, Li Xian at Lanzhou, Liu Hu at Shuiluo City, Guo Cheng at Huaiqing Army, Zhe Yuqing at Lanzhou, and Workshop Commissioner Wang Ji at Shengtang Stockade in Linzhou each had temples established for their achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shao at Xihe, Li Xian at Lanzhou, Liu Hu at Shuiluo City, Guo Cheng at Huaiqing Army, Zhe Yuqing at Lanzhou, and Workshop Commissioner Wang Ji at Shengtang Stockade in Linzhou each had temples established for their achievements.

sentences.zh: 寇準死雷州，人憐其忠，而趙普祠中山、韓琦祠相州，則以鄉里，皆載祀典焉。

translations.literal: Kou Zhun died in Leizhou and people pitied his loyalty; temples to Zhao Pu in Zhongshan and Han Qi in Xiangzhou were established on account of native place—all recorded in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: Kou Zhun died in Leizhou and people pitied his loyalty; temples to Zhao Pu in Zhongshan and Han Qi in Xiangzhou were established in their native places—all recorded in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 其他州縣嶽瀆、城隍、仙佛、山神、龍神、水泉江河之神及諸小祠，皆由禱祈感應，而封賜之多，不能盡錄雲。

translations.literal: Other prefectures and districts had shrines to peaks and streams, city gods, immortals and Buddhas, mountain spirits, dragon spirits, springs and rivers, and various minor shrines—all arising from responsive efficacy to prayers, with so many enfeoffments and grants that they cannot all be recorded.
